Info

Defines AxisSpeedProfileAnalyzer analyzing joint velocity, acceleration, and step peaks.

class scaralang.core.service.trajectory.metrics.profile.axis_speed_profile_analyzer.AxisSpeedProfileAnalyzer[source]¶

Bases: object

Profiles joint step execution to compute kinematic peak metrics per robot axis.

It defines:

attributes:
name - Identifier name of the speed profile analyzer.
methods:
analyze_axis_peaks - Computes peak kinematic metrics across all 4 robot axes.
analyze_single_axis - Computes peak metrics for a specific joint axis index.
analyze_axis_peaks(*, steps: tuple[Step, ...]) → tuple[AxisPeakMetric, ...][source]¶

Analyzes joint step execution across all 4 axes to compute peak metrics.

Parameters:

steps – Sequence of compiled binary motion steps.

Returns:

Tuple of AxisPeakMetric for J1, J2, Z, and J4.

analyze_single_axis(*, steps: tuple[Step, ...], axis_index: int, axis_name: str) → AxisPeakMetric[source]¶

Computes peak velocity, acceleration, and displacement for a single joint axis.

Parameters:

  • steps – Sequence of compiled motion steps.

  • axis_index – Coordinate index in target_steps (0=J1, 1=J2, 2=Z, 3=J4).

  • axis_name – Identifier name for the axis.

Returns:

AxisPeakMetric containing observed peaks.

property name: str¶

Gets the analyzer identifier name.

Returns:

Analyzer name string.
